20149.factory_part_name: Arcooda Parts 20149 Gun Holster for Arcade Machine
20149.long_desc: Our arcade machine gun holsters are designed for arcade operations and suitable for heavy arcade use. Steel constructions with powdercoated black finished, the Arcooda gun holster is suitable for all arcade light guns including Namco Time Crisis, Sega Virtua Cop, Sinden, Aimtrak, Pandaro guns, Atari, Midway. Traditional Arcade Gun Shooter Cabinets: perfectly suitable for your coin operated arcade machines. Our arcade gun holster is steel construction, with black powdercoating and suitable for extensive use in arcade stores, street sites. The arcade gun holsters are suitable for all older retro hand gun arcade machines such as Virtua Cop, Time Crisis, Area 51, Point Blank, Zero Point, House of the Dead, Lethal Enforcers and more. Home Light Gun Game Cabinets: if you are building your own cabinet, or, looking for the highest standard gun holsters, the Arcooda gun holster is the perfect choice. It supports almost all home gun light gun assemblies, including Sinden, Aimtrak, Namco, China Pandora, Fusion, Retro Shooter, Xenas, Gun4IR. Arcooda Arcade Cabinets: if you purchase a current series arcade machine, video/virtual pinball machine, these cabinets are "plug and play" ready for the Arcooda gun holster. Simple screw the gun holster into the gun hole location on the machines. The Arcooda gun holster is manufactured by us for arcade operators. Key features include; - 1.5mm to 4.8mm thickness steel construction - black rough featured powdercoating used to hide heavy use/scratches in arcade environment - including soft internal cushioning for gun protection - suitable for left or right cabinet mounting - designed to be away from the shell of the cabinet to avoid cabinet damage - suitable for almost any arcade hand gun cabinet, replace rusted/broken holsters - suitable for almost all home lightgun products - plug and play into any late model Arcooda arcade machines including Xtreme 3.0, Tempest and Virtual Pinball machines
